messages:
maya: Heads-up: found a parity issue in the sampleapps' telemetry/logging. Node vs Go behave differently for log-level mapping, request-id propagation, and redaction — Go is leaking user.email in some cases :alarm_clock:
sam: Can you paste the exact log line and a tiny repro? which SDK versions are we talking about?
maya: sampleapp v0.3.2. Node SDK 1.8.0, Go SDK 1.4.1. Example from Go stdout: `INFO user.Login successful user.email=alice@example.com req_id=abc123` Node shows: `INFO user.Login successful req_id=abc123 user_email=[REDACTED]`
ivan: That's concerning — redaction mismatch. Do we know whether redaction is done by the SDK logging hook or somewhere else in the pipeline?
maya: Quick audit: Node applies a sanitizer in devex/logging.js (logging hook) which rewrites user_email before the logger prints. Go sampleapp only redacts in the OTLP exporter path (right before send). So logs that happen before exporter still show raw fields.
chloe: Also noticed onboarding docs instruct `export REDACT_EMAILS=true` but that env var is only read by the Node quickstart. Go sampleapp doesn't reference it in config. Onboarding friction there.
sam: Do we have tests that cover parity? We should add a tiny e2e that runs both sampleapps and asserts no raw email patterns in logs. @maya can you add repro/PR?
maya: Minimal repro below:
```go
// sampleapp/main.go
log.Infof("user.Login successful user.email=%s req_id=%s", user.Email, ctx.Value("req_id"))
// no sanitizer middleware in example
```
Node snippet for comparison:
```js
// sampleapp/index.js
logger.info('user.Login successful', { req_id: reqId, user_email: sanitize(user.email) })
```
telemetry-bot: Notice: new telemetry mismatch issue opened: #5783 by maya — severity=medium — labels: telemetry, sampleapp
ivan: :eyes: I'll dig into the Go exporter ordering. My hunch: logging occurs before OTEL processors run, so redaction in exporter won't affect earlier log statements.
sam: Short-term workaround: add a sanitized log wrapper in Go sampleapp to strip PII fields before calling logrus. Long-term fix: unify sanitizer placement so both SDKs sanitize at the logging hook level.
maya: I pushed branch `fix/go-sample-redact` with a middleware that strips PII from structured log fields — works locally, needs CI and a test.
chloe: We should also standardize environment flags. REDACT_EMAILS vs TELEMETRY_REDACT_EMAIL is confusing; docs PR incoming to unify.
sam: I'll own adding an SDK parity test that runs both quickstarts, captures stdout, and asserts there are no email regex matches. ETA EOD tomorrow.
ivan: I'll add a CI step: run sampleapp quickstart for 30s, grep logs for email regex, fail build on any matches. That will surface regressions in PRs early.
maya: Also noticed request-id differences: Node attaches `x-request-id` header to outbound HTTP/OTLP calls and populates log context; Go sets `req_id` in context but doesn't add header for downstream RPCs. Might be a separate bug but worth checking since it's part of trace/log correlation.
sam: Good catch — I'll add header propagation check to the parity test.
telemetry-bot: Reminder: tag PRs with `telemetry` and `sampleapp`. Linking issue #5783.
maya: Thanks all — really appreciate quick turnaround. Leaving checklist: 1) short-term Go sanitizer PR (done), 2) parity test for logs+headers (sam), 3) CI quickstart log-scan (ivan), 4) docs env var unification (chloe).
